Computer vision · Earth observation

Md Muntaqim Meherab

Computer Vision & Remote Sensing Researcher

I study robust and computationally efficient computer vision for remote sensing and climate applications—how pretrained visual representations adapt, and when predictive confidence remains informative.

I am a Computer Science & Engineering undergraduate at Daffodil International University, expecting to graduate in June 2027. My recent work examines frozen vision transformers, flood segmentation under cloud occlusion, and robustness to noisy or missing inputs.

Better features may already
be inside the model.

NEURIPS 2026 · TCCML WORKSHOPClimate AI

When visibility falls,
does confidence follow?

A controlled study of optical, radar, and fused flood-segmentation models examines whether predictive confidence reflects the loss of information under synthetic cloud occlusion.
